name: real_event_eval_v1
relation_to_v1_protocol: Uses the frozen roles of rflymad_online_normal_adapt_v1 (real_case_roles_v1.csv) and its event-level primary metrics. No target-domain adaptation (A0 only); no Real data used for training, adaptation, thresholds or selection. Real was viewed in earlier rounds with other models and the legacy input; this run is reported as a frozen confirmatory evaluation, not a blind test.

population.main: test_normal (33 cases) and test_fault (392: 223 motor, 169 sensor)
population.label_quarantine: 9 cases flagged in tasks.json: fault detection metrics exclude them and report the count; normal metrics unaffected

timeline: causal_input_v1 cases, full crop, 20 ms grid, frame scored when the 150-frame history is fully input-valid (same as ens_event_replay_val_v1)

arms.M0@0.60: M0 B best.pt, deployment default onset
arms.M0@0.70: M0 B best.pt, onset chosen by common_fa_target_v1
arms.ENS@0.75: mean of M0 B and full-train GBT pkl, onset chosen by common_fa_target_v1

event_policy_fixed: clear 0.4, k_on 3, k_off 3, min_event 0.5 s, merge 0.5 s
onset_reference: first frame with row_label_valid and reference_state == 1 (Real ROS-based reference from causal_input_v1); not physical damage truth

metrics.normal_case_event_false_alarm_rate: cases with >=1 final event lying entirely in label-valid normal time / cases
metrics.false_alarm_events_per_hour: such events / valid normal exposure hours; also alarm occupancy
metrics.fault_case_event_recall: fault cases with a new confirmation at or after onset / fault cases scored after onset; motor and sensor separately
metrics.pre_onset_alarm: fault cases with an event spanning onset, reported separately, never as negative latency
metrics.latency: confirmation time minus onset, median/P90, and paired on cases detected by both arms
metrics.secondary: window-level FPR/recall at 0.5 on the cap64 supervised windows (Real role windows)

decision: Descriptive comparison, no pass/fail. ENS is credited only for differences versus M0@0.70 (same false-alarm target).
forbidden: changing arms, thresholds or policy after Real access
